subject: 國立嘉義大學蘭潭圖資前棟截段 — 雙端上圓筒與錐頂前半限域配色
scope: Additive appearance on the original front-section model only. The large flat rear face is an artificial display truncation, not a verified rear elevation or a complete library building. No geometry, face order or model count change.
result: PASS with a modest but visible benefit: the two end turrets have distinguishable warm-white upper skins and silver-gray roof slopes. The effect is localized and does not justify coloring the mixed central walls, glazing, lower brick cylinders or unsupported rear halves. No mandatory visual correction remains.

personal_pixel_review.official_front: The full 2015 × 1344 photograph was personally examined. The building is behind a foreground public-art figure and is slightly defocused. Both end turret skins read as white and their roofs as gray, but blurred fine details were not used to infer subdivisions or materials.
personal_pixel_review.official_angle: The full 1752 × 1168 oblique photograph was personally examined. The near upper cylinder has white opaque strips around recessed windows, and its tapered metal roof is silver-gray. The far turret corroborates the repeated form. Trees, public art and other buildings are not model inputs.
personal_pixel_review.original_preview: The original monochrome preview was personally examined. Existing window/column geometry and truncated rear scope are historical approximations, not newly reconstructed by this appearance layer.
personal_pixel_review.previews/front.png: Both upper turret skins are visibly lighter, with restrained gray roof slopes. Hole walls and recessed window backs remain neutral. Main facade and lower cylinders are not recolored. The entire model fits the frame.
personal_pixel_review.previews/rear.png: The artificial rear cut-face and unsupported roof/skin halves stay neutral. This view documents the model truncation, not an independently sourced rear elevation.
personal_pixel_review.previews/elevation.png: The two small but recognizable white/gray end accents are coherent and symmetric in scope. The mixed central windows and walls remain neutral; there is no blanket green-glass or red-brick claim.
personal_pixel_review.previews/side.png: The front-half selection ends at y=-4 and creates a visible color boundary. This is an explicit evidence limit, not a claimed physical material joint. Window reveals, ring band and back half stay neutral.
personal_pixel_review.previews/top.png: Only the front halves of both sloping roofs are colored. Horizontal top disks, back halves and broad building roof surfaces remain neutral. No texture or hidden new geometry is used.

independent_findings.original_files: All seven materialized originals were checked for byte count, SHA256 and Git blob hashes. Original, working and research STL bytes are identical.
independent_findings.exact_exchange: Direct binary-STL and independent 3MF XML parsing confirm every coordinate, original face sequence and winding for 6510 triangles and 3233 unique vertices. All three per-triangle material assignments and the three opaque palette colors match. One untransformed mesh is used.
independent_findings.finite_facets: Reviewer-owned scalar tests cover original 64-facet support planes i=32..63 for both centers (-62,-4) and (62,-4). All three vertices must satisfy the supporting plane, tangent extent of that finite facet, correct cylinder/cone z limits, y<=-4, and radial/vertical normal conditions. This is not a centroid or bounding-box approximation.
independent_findings.counts_and_area: Exactly 132 cylinder faces and 64 roof faces per turret: 264 warm-white plus 128 silver-gray, with 6118 neutral faces. Float64 area recomputed from actual STL vertices is 688.8276642394814 mm², agreeing with builder boundary QA; the research approximation 688.827637 differs by only 0.00002724 mm², a numerical precision difference, not a selection difference.
independent_findings.rebuild: The eight final 3MF/map/palette/PNG files were independently byte-compared against the builder's separate clean directory and match. Builder strict-lib3mf and Blender vertex/material edit-save-reopen, reopened render and semantic validation reports were inspected, not independently rerun.
independent_findings.native_source: The inspected original-native audit reports Printable_NCYU with 6510 faces, one Warm stone preview only material and all indices zero. The reviewer independently verified the original scene file byte/blob hashes but did not rerun that native audit.

dates_and_source_limits.front_photo: Independent EXIF/XMP inspection found no DateTime, DateTimeOriginal, DateTimeDigitized or XMP packet. Capture date remains unknown. The 2023-04-28 page date is publication, not capture.
dates_and_source_limits.angle_photo: Independent EXIF inspection found Original and Digitized 2018:05:30 13:42:31; main DateTime is 2018:10:11 18:24:33. XMP CreateDate is 2018-05-30T13:42:31; ModifyDate and MetadataDate are 2018-10-11T18:24:33+08:00. The modification offset is not transferred to the unzoned capture timestamp, and camera-clock accuracy was not independently established.
dates_and_source_limits.temporal_scope: The 2018 metadata applies only to the oblique photograph, not to the undated front photograph. No claim of 2026 conditions or a complete same-date survey.
dates_and_source_limits.color_scope: #DDDCD2 and #969DA0 are uncalibrated opaque visual proxies, not official paint specifications or sampled material measurements. The y=-4 boundary is a conservative evidence boundary, not a natural seam. Neutral surfaces mean unconfirmed, not verified gray.

manufacturing_and_identity_limits: Original front-section geometry only; no full-building promotion, invented rear structure or new model count.
Existing window-hole dimensions, ribs, roof proportions and artificial rear closure remain approximations. Color does not repair these source limitations.
No physical-print test, new toolpath analysis or rerun of historical manufacturing QA. No support-free or minimum-wall certification.
Source photographs and metadata remain private; they are not embedded in 3MF, Blend, previews or public backup. The original model license is not expanded to third-party images.
release_boundary: Private reviewer QA only; no main-repository edits or publication. Both reports must be included in checksum coverage and the final actual ZIP. The ZIP requires a separate member closure check; changed bound core or images require renewed review.
